about: Karolyn Hicks is an attorney providing legal services covering Estate & Trust Litigation and Alternative Dispute Resolution.

Karolyn Hicks, who practices law in Seattle, Washington, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2013 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at American University Washington College of Law. She graduated in 2000. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 2000.
